## Talk plan

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="68%"}
- Who I am, epiforecasts and the epinowcast community, and who else
  works on this with me
- Composable infectious disease modelling. The gap, what composable
  means, two approaches, one replication
- Where AI might plug in. A network as a component, agents building
  and checking the parts
- Recent delays work. `primarycensored`, `epidist`,
  `CensoredDistributions.jl`
- The workflow, and where AI sits
